entries.reason: Bun is MIT-licensed but statically links JavaScriptCore/WebKit (LGPL-2.0-or-later and LGPL-2.1-or-later, with BSD portions) and other native libraries listed in its LICENSE.md. LGPL static-link and relink obligations and the written source offer need legal review before an APK with the packaged runtime is distributed.
